Name: Sony CrSDK Camera Plugin for N.I.N.A.
Author: isky

Descriptions.ShortDescription: SONY CrSDK 相机接入与共享控制 / SONY CrSDK camera integration and shared controls.
Descriptions.LongDescription:
## 中文

通过 Sony Camera Remote SDK 在 N.I.N.A. 中使用 Sony 相机：普通曝光、软件 Bulb、ISO/快门控制、JPEG 实时预览与 Bayer RAW 解码；SONY 扩展控制面板与标准相机入口共享同一连接。

可解决 Sony A7M5（ILCE-7M5）等相机无法连接 N.I.N.A. 的问题。

**环境与兼容性**：Windows x64、N.I.N.A. 3.x（最低 3.2.0.9001）、Microsoft VC++ v14 x64 运行库。实机验证机型为 Sony A7 V（ILCE-7M5，固件 2.00）；其他机型尚未实机验证，插件按机身实际返回的能力工作（ISO/快门候选、Bulb、RAW 格式、保存位置），遇到不支持的能力会明确拒绝。

**安装（首次约 5 分钟）**：

1. 安装 N.I.N.A. 3.2.0.9001 或更高版本，以及 Microsoft VC++ x64 运行库。
2. 从 [Sony 官方开发者网站](https://support.d-imaging.sony.co.jp/app/sdk/licenseagreement_d/en.html)取得 Camera Remote SDK 2.02.00（Windows x64，需同意 Sony 许可协议），解压其中的 SimpleCli。发布包不包含、也不会自动下载 Sony SDK，请自行合法获取。
3. 在 N.I.N.A. 插件管理器安装本插件并重启 N.I.N.A.。插件启动时只检测已配置的 SDK，不安装文件、不提权。
4. 打开 选项 → 插件 → SONY CrSDK Camera 的 **SDK 配置** 页，选择解压后的 SimpleCli 目录并确认导入。写入受保护的共享适配器目录时，Windows 会请求一次管理员授权。SDK 配置不会连接相机。
5. 机身设置：M 档、手动对焦（MF）、仅 RAW、单张拍摄（Single Shooting）。
6. 在 设备 → 相机 中选择 **SONY CrSDK Camera** 连接，先拍一张短曝光验证。

升级时个人设置与 SDK 缓存自动保留；卸载步骤见安装文档。

**拍摄一致性**：ISO 与快门在跳过写入或提交曝光前都会刷新并回读；实际值与请求值不符时不触发快门，图像元数据使用已确认的实测参数。

[安装、升级与卸载](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md) · [使用说明](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md) · [兼容性](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)

独立社区项目，与 Sony 或 N.I.N.A. 官方无隶属关系，由 isky 维护。

---

## English

Use Sony cameras in N.I.N.A. through Sony Camera Remote SDK: normal exposures, software Bulb, ISO/shutter control, JPEG LiveView and Bayer RAW decoding. The SONY control panel and the standard camera interface share one connection.

It also lets cameras such as the Sony A7M5 (ILCE-7M5) connect to N.I.N.A. where the bundled support falls short.

**Requirements and compatibility**: Windows x64, N.I.N.A. 3.x (minimum 3.2.0.9001) and the Microsoft VC++ v14 x64 runtime. Sony A7 V (ILCE-7M5, firmware 2.00) is the hardware-validated model; other models have not been validated on hardware and are driven by the capabilities each body actually reports (ISO/shutter candidates, Bulb, RAW format, save destination). Unsupported capabilities are refused explicitly.

**Installation (about 5 minutes the first time)**:

1. Install N.I.N.A. 3.2.0.9001 or later and the Microsoft VC++ x64 runtime.
2. Obtain Camera Remote SDK 2.02.00 (Windows x64) from [Sony's official developer site](https://support.d-imaging.sony.co.jp/app/sdk/licenseagreement_d/en.html) (Sony license agreement applies) and extract its SimpleCli. The package does not contain or download the Sony SDK; get it legally yourself.
3. Install this plugin from the N.I.N.A. plugin manager and restart N.I.N.A. At startup the plugin only detects an already configured SDK; it never installs files or elevates.
4. Open Options → Plugins → SONY CrSDK Camera → **SDK setup**, select the extracted SimpleCli directory and confirm the import. Writing the protected shared-adapter directory asks for Windows administrator consent once. SDK setup does not connect to a camera.
5. On the camera body: M mode, manual focus (MF), RAW only, Single Shooting.
6. Select **SONY CrSDK Camera** under Equipment → Camera, connect, and take a short test exposure.

User preferences and SDK caches are preserved across upgrades; removal steps are in the installation guide.

**Capture consistency**: ISO and shutter are refreshed and read back before a write is skipped or an exposure is submitted. A mismatch blocks the shutter, and image metadata uses the verified values.

[Installation, upgrade and removal](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md) · [Usage](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md) · [Compatibility](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)
